title: ሕልም የወሰደኝ ጉዞ
audience: University students, especially those living away from home
intent: Help students living away from home feel understood and see that leaving home does not mean forgetting it; growth, resilience, and new friendships can create a second sense of home.
style_block: Cinematic, realistic Ethiopian university-life photography; natural light; emotionally restrained expressions; warm, grounded colors; authentic Ethiopian settings and people; no text or logos in generated images. Keep the protagonist's face, age, deep teal hijab, beige modest outfit, and backpack consistent in every shot.

character.description: A fictional 21-year-old Ethiopian Muslim university student with warm brown skin and dark brown eyes. She wears a deep teal hijab and a modest beige outfit. Her appearance, clothing, and age remain consistent throughout.
character.reference_status: Not generated; create and approve a character/style reference before production keyframes.
